visualCharacteristics.purpose: intro text beside a booking inquiry form with honeypot, optional reCAPTCHA and submit

contentPattern.structure: a one-cell intro row (heading + text); then one row per field: Label | type | value [| name]. type is text, email, tel, textarea, hidden, honeypot, recaptcha or submit; end a label with * for required or (optional) for optional; value is the textarea default text, input placeholder, hidden value or reCAPTCHA site key. Config rows: action | URL, method | post, success | message, error | message

reuseGuidance: Use for simple contact/booking forms posting to an external endpoint. Submits with fetch (no-cors when cross-origin, so a cross-origin post is reported as sent without reading the reply); a filled honeypot is silently dropped.
